### 1. What the user expresses; simulator mode

Persona: "you are keeping the cabinets, you are not cancelling anything, and you would like the late-delivery credit put on your order"; phone 6145550568, then DOB 1977-11-02, ZIP 43026 if asked; order SO-0471-718842; "If asked, you say you let Ridgeline's installation quote lapse back in June ... and that you have a Ridgeline credit card"; "If the agent brings up the damage claim ... you told the delivery crew you would keep the cabinets with an allowance"; "If the agent explains that other charges or credits have to be put on the order before the delay credit can be worked out, you say that is fine and they should go ahead"; "When the agent tells you the credit amount and hands you the step to accept the delay credit yourself, you accept it at that amount."
Object (delay remedy on SO-0471-718842), timing (now), boundary (keep, credit not cancellation), authorisation (go-ahead for the other lines; customer runs the acceptance) are clear. Simulator passive/conditional; never names which lines.

### 4. Scored parameters

#### 4a. Damage allowance (post_damage_allowance_1c94fd89, `allowance_amount`)

Computation doc_special_deposit_program_damage_allowance_amount: "the program's damage allowance percentage of the order total billed on the order, rounded to the nearest cent" (15% x 4860.00 = 729.00 baseline).
Factors:
- doc_special_installation_status_allowance_rate: "a contract there that is cancelled ... gives 16 percent". Contract at delivery address cancelled -> 16 (replaces 15).
- doc_special_damage_claim_timing_multiplier: "a claim registered on the completed date itself gives a report multiplier of 1.1". Claim 2026-09-30 = completed date -> 1.1.
- doc_special_ready_item_holding_multiplier: "more than 45 days gives a holding multiplier of 1.1". Ready 2026-08-13 -> completed 2026-09-30 = 48 days -> 1.1.
- doc_special_vendor_lateness_allowance_goodwill: after rounding, "beyond the threshold but not beyond twice it, 75.00 is added". 38 days late, threshold 21 (22-42) -> +75.00.
Assembly: 4860.00 x 0.16 x 1.1 x 1.1 = 940.896 -> 940.90; + 75.00 -> **allowance_amount = 1015.90**.

#### 4b. Home delivery charge (bill_deposit_delivery_6add7fad, `delivery_charge`)

Computation doc_special_deposit_program_delivery_charge_amount: program fee 149.00 (tariff), not linked -> baseline 149.00.
Factors:
- doc_special_load_value_delivery_rate (method, starting amount): "A billed total of at least 3 times the program's order minimum is charged the greater of the program's home delivery fee and 3.5 percent of the billed total". 4860.00 >= 4500.00; 3.5% = 170.10 > 149.00 -> 170.10.
- doc_special_consumer_credit_cardholder_delivery_share: "an active account opened at least 60 whole months before today gives a cardholder share of 0.85". Opened 2019-06-10 (87 whole months) -> 0.85.
- doc_special_handover_inspection_delivery_share: "damaged — cosmetic, with none recording damaged — functional or wrong item, gives 0.75" -> 0.75.
- doc_special_late_arrival_delivery_share: "more than the threshold and not more than twice it gives 0.75". 38 days -> 0.75.
- Not applicable (paid-in-full scope): order_size_delivery_rate, handover_condition_delivery_share, installation_job_site_delivery_share, probuild_member_delivery_discount, vendor_lateness_delivery_share.
Assembly: 170.10 x 0.85 x 0.75 x 0.75 = 81.329 -> **delivery_charge = 81.33**.

#### 4c. Storage charge (bill_storage_fee_4a2244a6, `storage_days`, `storage_fee`)

Computation doc_special_storage_charge_amount: days ready->completed less free hold, x fee per day, rounded, capped. Schedule "Semi-Custom Cabinetry | yes | 2 | 30 | 10.00 | 300.00". Baseline: 48 - 30 = 18 days x 10.00 = 180.00.
Factors:
- doc_special_late_arrival_free_hold_extension: "more than the threshold and not more than twice it adds 7 days" -> +7.
- doc_special_receipt_delay_free_hold_extension: shipped 2026-08-07 -> store receipt inspection 2026-08-13 = 6 days; "more than twice the program's receipt inspection period adds 4 days" (period 2) -> +4.
- Free hold 30 + 7 + 4 = 41 -> storage days 48 - 41 = 7.
- doc_special_weekly_storage_day_count: "at least 7 but fewer than 21 are billed as 6 days for every full 7 days plus each remaining day" -> 6 billable days; "the storage fee line records the billable days as its days of storage billed".
- doc_special_order_size_storage_share: 4860.00 is at least 2x (3000.00) but below 4x (6000.00) the 1500.00 minimum -> 0.95.
- doc_special_consumer_credit_project_storage_share: active, 2 special-order/installation purchases in the last 12 months -> 0.75.
- doc_special_quoted_installation_storage_share: "a cancelled contract on which the customer made payments gives a share of 0.8"; the cancelled contract has a 99.00 payment line -> 0.8.
Assembly: 6 x 10.00 x 0.95 x 0.75 x 0.8 = 34.20, under the 300.00 cap -> **storage_days = 6, storage_fee = 34.20**.

#### 4d. Delay credit (accept_delay_credit_eaface8f, `credit_amount`)

Computation doc_special_delay_credit_amount: credit base = order total billed + every home delivery fee billed - every damage allowance credited; programme percentage of it, rounded, held to the maximum. After 4a-4c: base = 4860.00 + 81.33 - 1015.90 = 3925.43.
Factors:
- doc_special_delay_length_credit_rate: delay 38; "more than 1.5 times the threshold and not more than twice it gives 6 percent" (31.5 < 38 <= 42) -> 6 (replaces 5).
- doc_special_damage_allowance_credit_rate_cut: "allowances totalling at least 20 percent of the order total billed give an allowance cut of 1"; 1015.90 >= 972.00 -> -1 point.
- doc_special_lost_installation_credit_bonus: "a contract cancelled on or before the promised ready date gives 0.5"; cancelled 2026-06-04 <= 2026-07-06 -> +0.5.
- doc_special_production_length_credit_bonus: production start 2026-05-20 -> shipped 2026-08-07 = 79 days, "more than 60 days gives a production bonus of 1" -> +1.
- doc_special_prompt_claim_credit_bonus: completed 2026-09-30 -> today 2026-10-08 = 8 days, "more than 7 days and no more than 30 days gives 0.5" -> +0.5.
- doc_special_customer_wait_credit_settlement: own wait 48 days, "an own wait of more than 45 days halves it, rounded to the nearest cent", applied after rounding and the maximum.
Assembly: rate 6 - 1 + 0.5 + 1 + 0.5 = 7 percent; 3925.43 x 0.07 = 274.7801 -> 274.78 (<= 500.00); halved -> **credit_amount = 137.39**.

Fall-back answer (computation documents only, every hop done at baseline): allowance 729.00, delivery 149.00, storage 18 days / 180.00, delay credit 5% x (4860.00 + 149.00 - 729.00) = 214.00. With no hop done: 5% x 4860.00 = 243.00. Both definite and different from 137.39.

Findability: each factor was reached from record words — "Ridgeline Installation Services" contract (status cancelled, cancelled date, payment line), "Ridgeline Consumer Credit" account (status, opened date, purchase lines with purchase_channel special_order/installation), store receipt inspection and shipped dates, customer handover condition, ready/promised/completed/production dates, damage allowance credit lines, order billing line. No computation document announced a variation by "unless"/"adjustments" wording. One observation for the scan: doc_special_deposit_program_delivery_charge_amount answers "Does the order total matter here? Not in this determination: the charge is the program's home delivery fee." — I did not use it to find the load/value document (found by reading the corpus by delivery-charge subject), but the qualifier "in this determination" is noted for the dependency-form scan.

No."; storage reads no fee/credit); all three precede step 7, whose credit base and allowance cut read the allowance and delivery lines.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Problems: P1 root (customer) accept the delay credit; P2 (agent) book the owed damage allowance credit; P3 (agent) bill the owed home delivery charge; P4 (agent) bill the owed storage charge. Direction: P1 waits on P2, P3, P4; none of P2-P4 states a prerequisite. Order: P2, P3, P4 in any order, then P1.

- P1 -> P2 — **state-derived**. Sentence (blocked hub doc_special_delay_credit_acceptance): "not worked out until every damage allowance owed for a damage claim registered on the order stands as a credit on it." Records: claim with `remedy_choice 'damage_allowance'`, `status 'submitted'`, no allowance credit line. Write found by searching "damage allowance credit" for a deposit program: doc_special_deposit_program_damage_allowance_credit "when ... the customer's damage claim already records the choice to keep the item with an allowance. The allowance is booked once, as a damage allowance credit against that claim" / "adds one damage allowance credit line". The paid-in-full acceptance tool excluded by its "deposit at order is 100 percent" scope.
- P1 -> P3 — **state-derived**. Sentence: "Before the delay credit is fixed, the home delivery charge owed for a delivered order must stand on the order as a fee line." Records: delivered, not linked, no fee line. Write: doc_special_deposit_program_delivery_charge_line "Billing the charge adds one home delivery fee line"; the paid-in-full twin excluded by scope.
- P1 -> P4 — **state-derived**. Sentence: "A delay credit on an order the store has released is booked only after the storage charge owed for the days held past the free hold period stands on the order." Records: completed after 48 days at store, no storage fee line. Write: doc_special_storage_charge_line "once the item has left the store ... billed as one storage fee line".
- No hop pre-solved: the hub names only its own tool; no other tool, route or ordered list.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Cancellation remedy instead of credit: excluded by the customer ("not cancelling") and by "An order already shipped earns only the delay credit".
- Delay measured from the estimated date vs the ready date: identical here (both 2026-08-13); "the ready date, once the item is ready" fixes it.
- Allowance figured on order total vs delivered price: deposit-program computation "figured on the order total billed only"; the paid-in-full delivered-price rule is scoped to 100 percent programs.
- Allowance percentage 10 (scheduled contract tier) vs 16 vs 15: contract status recorded `cancelled` -> 16.
- Storage days on the line: raw 7 vs billable 6 — weekly note "the storage fee line records the billable days as its days of storage billed".
- Free-hold extensions cumulative: each "adds ... to the free hold"; both bands are satisfied independently.
- Settlement before or after the maximum: customer-wait document "once rounded to the nearest cent and held to no more than the program's delay credit maximum".
- Retired base clause ("delay credit of the delay credit percentage of the order total, capped at the delay credit maximum") marked "no longer in force".
- "Do only the one thing asked" (hand over the delay credit at once at 5% of 4860.00 = 243.00): excluded by the three conditions; each names a state the records show is absent, and the credit base by its definition reads the delivery fee and allowance lines which are not yet on the order.
